name: The slides
what: The welcome slides, unchanged. Skip and the last Next now lead to the picks.

versions.label: One page, then picks
versions.what: One page about Off Grid AI, then Get Started goes to the picks. The four slides and the Sync slide are gone.

name: What do you want to do?
what: Pick the jobs you want. Chat is picked to start.

versions.label: Soft main button
versions.what: Continue is the soft emerald main button.

name: Which ones?
what: The features in each picked group. With Pro already active there is no Get Pro offer.

versions.label: Soft main button
versions.what: Show me how it works is the soft emerald main button.

name: How it works
what: One card per pick. Tap to see it; then set up the models.

versions.label: Soft main button
versions.what: Set up my models is the soft emerald main button.

name: How it works: Images
what: A pick opens its guide page, with a way to start right away.

versions.label: Make a picture
versions.what: The action says Make a picture, in the soft main button.

name: Model setup
what: Model setup comes checked for the picks: text, image and speech here.

versions.label: Before: on main
versions.what: Model setup on main, before picks: the same tiers, with no link to what you picked.

versions.label: Soft Download button
versions.what: Download is the soft emerald main button.

name: Home: your picks
what: Home leads with what you picked.

versions.label: Picks open ready
versions.what: Your picks: Images and Video Studio open their feature ready, not a plain chat.

name: Settings: What you use
what: Change the picks any time. Home follows at once.

name: Home after a change
what: Adding Ask your documents put Projects on Home.

name: Sync: saved devices
what: Each icon sits on its name line; the status dot sits on the first status line, under the icon.

name: Images pick: chat ready to draw
what: With an image model, the Images pick opens a chat already in image mode: What should it draw?, three starters, the style strip.

name: Images pick: first picture
what: A starter draws a picture on the phone (58 s on the OnePlus), with Restyle under it.

name: Images pick: low memory
what: With 2.2 GB free on the phone, the image model is refused with Free memory & retry and Run anyway. Run anyway made the picture.

name: Images pick: no model yet
what: With no image model, the Images pick opens Models on the Image tab.

name: Video Studio pick: no model yet
what: With no video or chat model, the Video Studio pick opens Models on the Video tab.

name: Models: search bar, scrolled
what: Rows now scroll under a search bar with its own surface and edge shadow (was a bare field). Shared ListSearchBar; lint refuses a bare SearchField above a list.

name: Model setup: finishes at Continue
what: Found while shooting: the image model finished on disk (and Home lists it), but setup stayed at 98% with the spinner for 5+ minutes.

versions.label: Fixed: setup reads the last change
versions.what: A real 947 MB image zip (Absolute Reality, NPU) downloads, extracts and setup ends at Continue; Home then lists Image 2.
